changes.description: Add a workspaces array listing tools/warehouse-server and tools/warehouse-ui. Add scripts typecheck (npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present), build (npm run build -w @warehouse/ui), start (npm run build && npm run start -w @warehouse/server) and test:warehouse (npm run test -w @warehouse/server). The existing Java test script is untouched. Additions are purely additive because issue #3 also edits scripts. This is the only existing file modified.

Package @warehouse/server, private, type module, engines node >=22.13. Scripts: dev (tsx watch src/index.ts), start (tsx src/index.ts), typecheck (tsc -p tsconfig.json), test (tsx --test "src/**/*.test.ts"). Dependencies fastify ^5.2.1, @fastify/static ^8.1.0, tsx ^4.19.2. DevDependencies @types/node ^22.10.7, typescript ^5.7.3.
Extends ../bob-pipeline/tsconfig.base.json with types [node] and include [src].
TypeScript mirror of Vehicle.java fields (id, make, model, year, vin, color, mileage), plus input, query and paginated list types.

HttpError class and hand-written allow-list validators. parseVehicleInput enforces make/model 1-100 chars, vin 1-64 chars, color 0-50 chars, year safe integer 1886..currentYear+1, mileage safe integer >=0, rejects unknown/missing fields and ignores client id. parseId accepts only positive safe integers. parseVehicleQuery gives q trimmed max 100, page default 1 (>=1), pageSize default 10 (1-100). Invalid values throw HttpError(400).

WarehouseDb over node:sqlite (loadSqlite copied from the pipeline server, with a clear Node 22.13 error message). Constructor takes a filename or :memory:, sets WAL, creates the vehicles table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, make, model, year, vin UNIQUE, color, mileage CHECK >=0). Parameterised SQL only. The list query filters make/model/vin/color with LIKE ... ESCAPE (wildcards escaped), orders by id, uses LIMIT/OFFSET and a COUNT(*) with the same filter. UNIQUE violations are rethrown as DuplicateVinError.

buildApp(db, opts) builds the Fastify instance without listening, so it is testable via app.inject. Routes: GET/POST /api/vehicles, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/vehicles/:id (201 on create, 204 on delete, 404 when missing). Error handler returns { error } with HttpError status, 409 for DuplicateVinError, generic 'Bad request' for other 4xx, and a logged-server-side generic 500 'Internal server error' with no stack or SQL leakage. If opts.webDist exists, registers @fastify/static with an index.html fallback for non-/api paths, mirroring the pipeline server.

Entry point. Resolves WAREHOUSE_DATA_DIR (default ../.data relative to the file), mkdirs it, opens warehouse.sqlite, builds the app with webDist ../../warehouse-ui/dist and listens on host 127.0.0.1 only, port PORT or 4323. Logs the URL.
node:test unit tests for parseVehicleInput, parseId and parseVehicleQuery covering limits, unknown/missing fields, ignored id, and bad ids and query params.

Unit tests on an in-memory WarehouseDb: CRUD round trip with column values equal to input, q filter across make/model/vin/color, LIKE wildcards treated literally, pagination total/items, duplicate VIN throws DuplicateVinError, delete of a missing id returns false, loadSqlite error message.

Smoke and scenario tests using buildApp(new WarehouseDb(':memory:')) and app.inject: full CRUD lifecycle and status codes, 400 on bad input, 404 on missing id, 409 on duplicate VIN, generic 500 body, create/filter/page/edit/delete scenario.

Package @warehouse/ui, private, type module. Scripts dev (vite), build (vite build), typecheck (tsc -p tsconfig.json). Dependencies with the same ranges as tools/bob-pipeline/apps/web: @tanstack/react-query ^5.64.1, react ^18.3.1, react-dom ^18.3.1, react-router-dom ^6.28.2. DevDependencies: @tailwindcss/vite ^4.0.0, tailwindcss ^4.0.0, @types/react ^18.3.18, @types/react-dom ^18.3.5, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.4, vite ^6.0.7, typescript ^5.7.3. Pipeline-only deps (shared, dagre, xyflow, diff, markdown, typography) are excluded.
Extends ../bob-pipeline/tsconfig.base.json with jsx react-jsx, lib [ES2022, DOM, DOM.Iterable], types [vite/client], include [src].
Plugins react() and tailwindcss(). server: port 4322, strictPort true, proxy /api to http://127.0.0.1:4323 (the warehouse server, not the pipeline server on 4321).
Copy of the pipeline web index.html with title 'Warehouse admin' and the same body classes (bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 antialiased); mounts /src/main.tsx.
@import "tailwindcss" plus the same :root font-family rule; no typography plugin.
QueryClientProvider (same defaults as the pipeline web app) and BrowserRouter with Layout route wrapping '/' (VehicleListPage), '/vehicles/new' and '/vehicles/:id/edit' (both VehicleFormPage).
Header bar titled 'Warehouse admin' linking to '/', plus an Outlet in a max-w-5xl main area, using the same Tailwind slate palette as the pipeline Layout.

Copies Button (default/primary/danger/ghost variants with identical class strings), Card and ErrorBox from the pipeline ui.tsx. Omits StatusBadge, timeAgo and duration, which depend on pipeline types.

Copies the request<T>() helper and api object from the pipeline web app, adding put and del and handling 204 responses. Redeclares Vehicle, VehicleInput and VehicleList (mirroring the server types). React Query v5 hooks invalidate ['vehicles'] on mutation; useVehicles uses placeholderData keepPreviousData.

Card with a search input (q; page resets to 1 on change), table of id/make/model/year/VIN/color/mileage with Edit link and Delete button, Prev/Next pagination with 'page X of Y' (pageSize 10), a 'New vehicle' button, and loading/empty/ErrorBox states. Delete sets pendingDelete and shows an overlay confirmation Card (make, model, VIN; Cancel and danger Confirm) that calls useDeleteVehicle.

Single create/edit form. Edit mode when the :id route param is present (loads useVehicle and pre-fills). Controlled inputs for make, model, year, vin, color, mileage with light client checks mirroring the server rules; server errors shown in ErrorBox. Submit calls create or update then navigates to '/'; Cancel is a ghost Button.

interfaces.name: GET /api/vehicles
interfaces.notes: q max 100 chars; page >=1 default 1; pageSize 1-100 default 10; invalid values return 400 { error }.

interfaces.name: GET /api/vehicles/:id
interfaces.notes: id must be a positive integer.

interfaces.name: POST /api/vehicles
interfaces.notes: 409 when the VIN already exists; a client-supplied id is ignored.

interfaces.name: DELETE /api/vehicles/:id
interfaces.notes: All error bodies are { error: string } with generic messages; no stack traces.

interfaces.name: Vehicle types
interfaces.signature: interface Vehicle { id: number; make: string; model: string; year: number; vin: string; color: string; mileage: number }; type VehicleInput = Omit<Vehicle, 'id'>; interface VehicleQuery { q: string; page: number; pageSize: number }; interface VehicleList { items: Vehicle[]; total: number; page: number; pageSize: number }

interfaces.name: validate.ts
interfaces.signature: class HttpError extends Error { constructor(status: number, message: string) }; parseVehicleInput(body: unknown): VehicleInput; parseId(raw: unknown): number; parseVehicleQuery(query: Record<string, unknown>): VehicleQuery

interfaces.name: WarehouseDb
interfaces.signature: class WarehouseDb { constructor(filename: string); listVehicles(query: VehicleQuery): VehicleList; getVehicle(id: number): Vehicle | null; createVehicle(input: VehicleInput): Vehicle; updateVehicle(id: number, input: VehicleInput): Vehicle | null; deleteVehicle(id: number): boolean }; class DuplicateVinError extends Error

interfaces.name: buildApp
interfaces.signature: buildApp(db: WarehouseDb, opts?: { webDist?: string }): Promise<FastifyInstance>

interfaces.name: UI API hooks
interfaces.signature: api.get<T>(url); api.post<T>(url, body); api.put<T>(url, body); api.del(url); useVehicles(params: VehicleListParams); useVehicle(id: number | undefined); useCreateVehicle(); useUpdateVehicle(id: number); useDeleteVehicle()
interfaces.notes: tools/warehouse-ui/src/api.ts; mutations invalidate the ['vehicles'] query key.

data_changes: New SQLite file warehouse.sqlite in WAREHOUSE_DATA_DIR (default tools/warehouse-server/.data, already gitignored via .data/), created on startup: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicles (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, make TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL, vin TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, color TEXT NOT NULL, mileage INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mileage >= 0)). No migration tooling needed.
Optional env vars: PORT (default 4323), WAREHOUSE_DATA_DIR, LOG_LEVEL (default warn). Server host is fixed to 127.0.0.1.

Root package.json gains workspaces [tools/warehouse-server, tools/warehouse-ui] and the scripts typecheck, build, start and test:warehouse. npm install generates a new root package-lock.json (new file, not a modification).

test_approach.what: npm run typecheck at the repo root exits 0 for both new packages (the tsc run is the AC-6 gate).
npm run build produces tools/warehouse-ui/dist; npm run start serves / and GET /api/vehicles on 127.0.0.1:4323 and returns empty items on a fresh database.
app.test.ts: buildApp with an in-memory database responds to all five endpoints with the expected status codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 404, 409).
Scenario in app.test.ts: create two vehicles, filter by q, page with pageSize=1, edit one via PUT, delete it; list and total reflect each step.

VehicleListPage and VehicleFormPage rendering (list, create, edit, delete confirmation) is not testable today because the repo has no UI test runner; deferred to the test-plan stage. For this issue the UI is gated by tsc and vite build.
validate.test.ts: field limits, unknown and missing fields, ignored client id, bad ids and bad query params rejected.
db.test.ts: persisted column values equal input, LIKE escaping, pagination arithmetic, duplicate VIN, deleteVehicle false for a missing id, loadSqlite error message.
Check that vite.config.ts server.proxy['/api'].target is http://127.0.0.1:4323 and not the pipeline's 4321.
git status after implementation shows only package.json modified, plus new files.

rollout: Issue #1 (Vehicle.java) is already on the base branch; issue #3 also edits root package.json scripts and should merge first if possible, otherwise resolve the additive conflict. Order: (1) root package.json workspaces and scripts, (2) tools/warehouse-server with its tests, (3) tools/warehouse-ui, then npm install at the root and run typecheck, test:warehouse and build. Nothing is deployed or enabled by default; the app runs only on demand. The existing Java test script, pipeline server and pipeline web app are unchanged. Rollback is deleting the two directories and reverting root package.json.
